acceptance: gate:quick-1 Fetch the FrankenKey release signing env from the desktop (Mac-mini) to this laptop. The file lives on the mini at /Users/apple/.android/frankenkey-release-signing/frankenkey-release.env (or under /Volumes/TheHoneyBadger/AndroidTooling/state/home/.android/frankenkey-release-signing/frankenkey-release.env). Copy it via ssh/scp to /Users/apple/.android/frankenkey-release-signing/frankenkey-release.env on this host, chmod 600. Do not print the file contents to output. Verify RELEASE_KEYSTORE_RELEASE_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD/RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS/RELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD keys are present. If SSH auth to the mini is not set up, report exactly what auth surface exists.
